slides.title: Adding Users
slides.html:
• Admin tools can be easily accessed from the sidebar.
  • To invite new users, select "Add Users."

slides.title: Invite Codes
slides.html: • Either select a current invite code or create a new one.

slides.title: Using the invite codes
slides.html:
• Users can scan the QR code from your device.
  • You can also copy and share an invite link or create a easily printable PDF with the invite QR.
  • Using the invite, users will be able to reach the waiting room.

slides.title: Approve Users
slides.html:
After showing your users the invite QR or sending them the link, you should now have users in the waiting room.

  • You can check that out by navigating there from the sidebar.

slides.title: Approving Users
slides.html:
You have a few options on approving users:

  • Scan the QR Code shown on their devices in person(recommended).
  • Order your users to copy and send you their Approve Link to you. Navigating that lets you accept them in instantly.
  • If QR or the accept link are not reachable for some reason, you can tap the user at Approve Users menu and enter the approval code shown on their device.

When accepting users (especially with links) be 100% sure the person is who you think they are. Accepting them gives access to for example troop locations if using TAK.

slides.title: Closing an invite code
slides.html:
• For increased security it is wise to either close or disable invite codes when they are not required.
  • Code management is opened by pressing the button next to the code.
